title: Fifteen-year-old arrested in shooting near Florida university that injured 12
summary_full: All but one of the victims sustained gunshot wounds as boy faces 11 charges of attempted second-degree murderOfficials in Florida have charged a 15-year-old boy with 11 counts of attempted murder following a mass shooting at a college homecoming party on Saturday.Six adults and six minors were injured, all but one with gunshot wounds, in the gunfire near the Florida Agricultural + Mechanical University (Famu) campus in Tallahassee.
